summary: This study fabricated four freestanding Ti3C2Tx-based vacuum-filtered films: pure MXene (MP0) and PANI-nanofiber composites MP2, MP5, and MP8, differentiated by 2, 5, or 8 mL PANI dispersion added to 10 mL MXene dispersion. Ti3C2Tx was obtained by LiF/HCl etching of Ti3AlC2 followed by delamination. MP5 was the headline optimum and had the highest reported film gravimetric capacitance, 425.7 F g−1 at 10 mV s−1 in 1 M H2SO4; its all-solid-state symmetric device reported 272.5 F g−1 at 1 A g−1 and 31.18 Wh kg−1 at 1079.3 W kg−1. Numerical capacitance values were not printed for MP0, MP2, or MP8, and film thickness, mass loading, and numerical interlayer d-spacings were not reported.
